Milestone `dossier`, goal `the-description-is-owed`, stage 2, **reached**. `data/proofs/policy.json`
carries `owes.all.about: true`, and `bun nv proofs --gate` passes over the whole roster with nothing
written: every feature owes tests, examples, perf, hostile, about and help, and none is owed.
`bun nv verify` is green, `bun nv verify --doc` resolves every link, and `bun nv owners --closes`
and `bun nv playbook --closes` name nothing for this goal.

**One thing for the user to look at, outside this goal.** `docs/reference/tools/20-config.md:65-70`
says `nvs run` enforces `[limits] memory` alone and that the server, database client and logger are
not in the binary. Both are out of date. A run under `[limits] cpu_time = "1s"` stops with
`FATAL: the request exceeded its CPU-time limit`, which is what line 165 of the same chapter says,
and `nvs --help` lists `serve`. Lines 181-182 say the same of the logger and the HTTP error pages
for `[mode]`. The paragraphs were left as they stand: a rewrite needs `[mode]`, `[log]`, `[http]`,
`[db]` and `[cache]` each run under `nvs run`, which was not checked, and no description states any
of it.

Gap `nvs-ir/throws-on-an-array-key-that` is owned by `milestone: M10`, and goal `coalesce-assign`,
still on the chain, deletes the record in the session that closes it
(`docs/agent/goals/coalesce-assign.md:83`). The two agree, and nothing is owed there.
